verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear left-hand stack (eyebrow, headline, subline, CTA, legal) with the product on the right, but the vertical spacing is cramped: the CTA nearly touches the subline and the legal line. The right end of the pill button looks clipped flat, and there is a dead gap between the text and the product circle. B scatters the pieces across the canvas with no grouping. The headline sits on the circle, which is cropped at the bottom edge, the subline floats away from the headline, the CTA sits in the top-right corner and the legal text drifts on its own, so the reading order is jumbled.
